lead.title: VectorY (Amsterdam) raises €74.5M for its vectorized anti-TDP-43 antibody, in Phase 1/2 for ALS
lead.deck: Angelini Ventures, Invest-NL and the European Investment Bank (a €30M convertible loan backed by InvestEU) join Forbion, EQT Life Sciences, Eli Lilly, MRL Ventures, Insight Partners and BioGeneration Ventures. VTx-002 uses an AAV to make central nervous system cells produce an antibody against abnormal TDP-43 protein; the PIONEER-ALS trial, which started dosing in February and was expanded from 12 to 36 patients in September, is funded through its final readout, and the platform will extend to Huntington's, frontotemporal dementia and Alzheimer's.

milestone.title: Epitopea doses the first patient in OVACT, the trial of its RNA vaccine CryptiVax-1001 in ovarian cancer
milestone.summary: A Phase 1/1b dose-escalation trial (NCT07665515) in women with advanced HRP+/BRCA-wildtype high-grade serous ovarian cancer: up to 30 patients at 10 UK centres, led by Prof. Susana Banerjee. The vaccine targets "Cryptigens", tumour antigens drawn from the dark genome and shared across patients.
milestone.why: It is the CryptoMap platform's first step into the clinic: antigens shared by many tumours allow an off-the-shelf vaccine with no personalised manufacturing, in a cancer where immunotherapy has so far had little success.

brefsEurope.title: Switchpoint Bio emerges from stealth with a $5.3M pre-seed to predict drug response from the epigenome
brefsEurope.summary: Treehouse Delmar Investments puts in $5M; founded by Samuel Myllykangas and Jason Buenrostro (who met at Stanford), the company reads DNA methylation in circulating immune cells from a blood draw to track treatment effects, using its own AI.

brefsEurope.title: Horizon Europe puts €8M into the HERMOD project around HER-096's Phase 2 in Parkinson's
brefsEurope.summary: The consortium is coordinated by Karolinska University Hospital with the Luxembourg Institute of Health and Skåne University Hospital: a randomized, placebo-controlled trial in about 100 newly diagnosed patients, with a trial application targeted for Q4 2026 and first dosing in H1 2027.

brefsEurope.title: Circio pairs its circVec circular RNA with Solid Biosciences' cardiac capsid to cut AAV doses
brefsEurope.summary: Circio designs the circVec constructs (about 200-fold higher cardiac expression in vivo, per the company) and Solid packages them in POLARIS-101, a capsid built to target heart muscle while sparing the liver; joint lab and animal testing, terms undisclosed.

brefsEurope.title: AAX Biotech and Discovery Evolution team up to design bispecific antibodies against hard membrane targets
brefsEurope.summary: AAX's Opti-mAb technology (scFv stability and yield) is combined with the RedQueen digital directed-evolution platform to go after GPCRs in oncology; research stage, no financial terms.

brefsEurope.title: Orexo and SVF Vaccines test a powder version of LNP-encapsulated mRNA vaccines
brefsEurope.summary: The study will check whether LNP-mRNA formulations spray-dried with AmorphOX keep their nanoparticle properties and mRNA activity, a potential way to remove the cold chain.

brefsEurope.title: Redalpine closes its eighth early-stage fund at $250M, biotech included
brefsEurope.summary: The oversubscribed fund (LPs include Aviva Investors, Flexstone Partners and KfW) will lead Seed and Series A rounds of $1–15M; early bets include Helical, a virtual AI lab for drug discovery.

brefsEurope.title: Bayer wins FDA approval for Sunharbo (asundexian), the first oral factor XIa inhibitor
brefsEurope.summary: Approved after a non-cardioembolic ischemic stroke or high-risk TIA, on top of antiplatelet therapy: a 26% cut in ischemic strokes versus placebo in OCEANIC-STROKE, with no increase in major bleeding. Comparable: regulatory validation of a new anticoagulant target.

brefsIntl.title: AstraZeneca acquires Omniose, a bioconjugate antibacterial vaccine specialist
brefsIntl.summary: Terms undisclosed; after a three-year collaboration, the platform that makes and joins polysaccharide and carrier protein inside a single bacterium moves into AstraZeneca's infectious disease unit, a signal for European bacterial vaccine players.

word.definition: The large share of our DNA long written off as "junk" (repeated sequences, viral remnants, hidden reading frames) which, when reawakened in tumours or autoimmune disease, supplies new drug targets.

parts.label: Endogenous retroviruses (HERVs)
parts.role: the viral fossils: at least 8% of the genome, normally kept silent

parts.label: Repeat elements (LINE-1…)
parts.role: the "repeatome": mobile sequences that can trigger inflammation

parts.label: Alternative reading frames
parts.role: the hidden proteins: fragments translated outside classic genes, such as DARKFOX within FOXM1

how.t: In a cancer cell, the DNA methylation and histone marks that lock these sequences go awry, and HERVs and other elements are transcribed again.
Their products are translated, cut into peptides and displayed on the tumour surface by MHC class I, making them antigens that healthy tissue lacks.
These antigens become targets for a vaccine, a T-cell engager or engineered T cells; conversely, blocking an enzyme such as LINE-1 reverse transcriptase aims to switch off autoimmune inflammation.

word.why: Classic targets are crowded; the dark genome offers tumour-specific antigens shared across patients, suited to off-the-shelf products. Pharma pays for access (Boehringer Ingelheim's licences from Enara Bio) and Epitopea has just entered the clinic. Due diligence watch-point: mass spectrometry proof that the antigen is truly presented on tumours, and absent from healthy tissue.

startups.name: Epitopea
startups.use: CryptoMap platform that finds dark-genome tumour antigens ("Cryptigens"); first patient dosed in November 2026 in the Phase 1/1b OVACT trial of its RNA vaccine CryptiVax-1001 (ovarian cancer).

startups.name: Enara Bio
startups.use: EDAPT "Dark Antigen" platform; Boehringer Ingelheim has licensed several of its targets, and its T-cell engager ENA101 (targeting DARKFOX, derived from FOXM1) is preparing to enter the clinic.

startups.name: ROME Therapeutics
startups.use: Mines the "repeatome": a LINE-1 reverse transcriptase inhibitor for lupus; nearly $200M raised since 2020, with J&J and BMS joining in 2023.
